description.en:
The general routine behind all AddParty_*_Message and AddPartyNum_*_Message helpers: adds one or more characters to the party, each with a jingle and a system message.
If _fade is 0 or more, the current BGM is stopped with that fade (CMND_SND_STOP) and the function waits until it has stopped. It then waits _wait frames (WaitFrame).
For each character in turn: the jingle _jingle is opened and played; the message placeholder 0 is set to the character (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA); the message _event is shown with CreateSpeech; the character is added with AddParty; and the function waits until the jingle has finished.
At the end, if _fade is 0 or more, the BGM plays again with the same fade.
The presets use jingle "J_08" (or "J_07" for the Important ones), message "sysmes-add_party" (or "sysmes-back_party" for the Back ones), and fade/wait 30 (or -1 for NoFadeBGM).
Number of characters to add; the arrays below are read from index 0 to _add_num - 1.
Parameter IDs of the characters, e.g. ["para_cp0001", "para_cp0013"].
One level per character; -1 (or any value of 0 or less) keeps the current level.
Fade used to stop and restart the BGM; -1 leaves the BGM alone. The presets use 30 or -1.
Frames to wait before the first jingle (WaitFrame). The presets use 30, or -1 with no fade.
Event sound played for each character, e.g. "J_08" or "J_07".
Not used by the function; the presets pass 0.
Message ID shown for each character, e.g. "sysmes-add_party" or "sysmes-back_party".

examples.case: What AddParty_Message("para_cp0015", true, false, false, 18) runs (real preset, from ie4_ev_main.nut and ev42070500.nut)
A custom jingle and message (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
// Keep the BGM, return message, important jingle
AddParty_MessageEx(1, ["para_cp0010"], [true], [true], [true], [-1], -1, -1, "J_07", 0, "sysmes-back_party");
